remarks: Welcome to this lovely Victorian in the heart of Allentown! Rich in character and timeless elegance, this home showcases beautiful hard wood floors, soaring windows that flood the space with natural light, and exquisite turn-of-the-century details throughout. A spacious wraparound front porch overlooking lush gardens sets the tone and warmly welcomes you to 41 Irving. Inside, the inviting foyer features a graceful, curved staircase, opening into a stunning double living room complete with a fireplace (NRTC), built-in bookcases, and original ceiling medallions. The formal dining room is perfect for entertaining, with a Victorian chandelier that has luminescent glass shades, abundant natural light, convenient powder room access, and a secondary staircase. A charming butler’s pantry provides additional storage and functionality. The generously sized eat-in kitchen offers ample cabinetry and a bright breakfast area, with sliding glass doors leading to a deck and private backyard. A versatile front room with a fireplace (NRTC) can serve as a parlor, home office, or den. Upstairs, the spacious primary bedroom features a decorative fireplace, a hallway walk-in closet adds additional storage. Three additional bedrooms and two full baths provide plenty of space, including one beautifully updated bath with a glass-enclosed shower, basket-weave tile, and modern vanity. Additional highlights include central air, The private backyard is a true retreat, featuring a deck with a new automatic Kohler awning, a tranquil koi pond, and thoughtfully designed landscaping. Ideally located near Downtown, Elmwood Village, Delaware Park, the AKG Museum, the medical campus, and more—this is a rare opportunity to own a piece of Buffalo’s architectural history.
